title: [CQ-M05] Recorded rollout controls
description:
Objective: Implement observation, selected-project enablement and audited rollback without downgrading active strict attempts.

Deliverable: Recorded rollout controls. This is task M05 of the approved full CQ rollout; consume this contract, not the whole reference document.

Scope boundaries: implement this behavior and its regression tests only. Later activation, other platform/client consumers and other task behaviors remain out of scope unless named here. Approved full CQ-01–CQ-08 rollout from the interactive implementation plan (2026-10-24). CQ-01 is already landed. Use original Moe source; daemon owns state, wrappers own host Git writes. User selected Moe-provisioned LOCAL Linux VMs (not cloud CI), coding/QA and checks isolated, and exact designated LOCAL BRANCH delivery. Strong profile stays disabled until isolation, evidence and client gates pass. Preserve legacy behavior and existing dirty bytes. Never directly edit .moe. No second revision authority, scheduler, graph database or native memory database.

Verification command (fresh, exit0 required): cd packages/moe-daemon && npm test

Dependency aliases (wired by Moe task ids after import): F12, R13, C11, V12, I06, M04.
definitionOfDone: Observation cannot authorize recipe bypass or verified completion.
Rollback retains evidence and strict task policy snapshots.
Fresh verification `cd packages/moe-daemon && npm test` exits0 and its output is supplied to complete_task.
taskRails: No direct .moe edits; no Git-write commands by agents; wrappers own landing.
Do not enable verified-local or claim isolation until all requisite implementation and certification gates pass.

implementationPlan.description:
Create packages/moe-daemon/src/state/profileRollout.ts (~130 lines) and delegate StateManager.updateSettings to it. Load ponytail first: reuse the validator, the leaf and the existing activity writer; add no store, setting, tool or event type.

Module doc: project settings writes and the recorded executionProfile rollout controls (CQ-M05): observation, selected-project activation and audited rollback. Every enablement is per project (settings live in this project's project.json; there is no fleet switch and, by the user's 2026-10-24 decision, no new UI). Nothing here grants readiness: assertExecutionProfileReady (delivery/executionProfile.ts, byte-unchanged) stays the only readiness authority, and the capability gate can only refuse.

Runtime imports only: ./validators.js (validateSettingsUpdate), ./attemptStore.js (currentAttempt), ../delivery/executionProfile.js (resolveExecutionProfile, readExecutionPolicySnapshot), ../server/clientCapabilities.js (decodeClientHello), ../util/atomicWrite.js (atomicWriteJsonAsync), ../util/errors.js (MoeError, MoeErrorCode), node path; StateManager and schema types are type-only. No new runtime cycle (stateModules.test.ts checks src/state).

Exports:
(a) type ProfileTransition = 'observe' | 'activate' | 'rollback'. classifyProfileTransition(from: ExecutionProfile | 'unreadable', to: ExecutionProfile): ProfileTransition | null. Rank legacy 0 < observe 1 < verified-local 2. A request for verified-local is 'activate'; from 'unreadable' or a lower rank is 'rollback'; a higher rank is 'observe'; equal is null.
(b) type ActivationGap = {capability: 'vm' | 'client' | 'check'; reason: string}. activationGaps(): ActivationGap[] returns fresh objects every call, ordered vm, client, check, from daemon-owned facts only (no env var, persisted label or caller input):
  - vm: no daemon-owned VM provisioning certification exists (R13 certifies on hardware; I03a vm-control reports executionReady/verified false by contract) -> 'vm-provisioning-uncertified';
  - client: decodeClientHello({protocolVersion:1, capabilities:{verifiedLocal:true}}).negotiatedCapabilities.verifiedLocal is the most I01 grants any client; false, or any throw -> 'client-contract-unsupported';
  - check: no certified isolated check runner (the /runner channel is untrusted outside isolation) -> 'check-runner-uncertified'.
  A later activation task may replace a fact with a certified daemon-owned source; M05 must not wire R13/I06/V12 producers.
(c) activationUnsupported(gaps): MoeError | null. null for []; else new MoeError(MoeErrorCode.NOT_ALLOWED, 'Execution profile verified-local cannot be activated: unsupported vm (<reason>), client (<reason>), check (<reason>).' listing only the given gaps, {executionProfile:'verified-local', unsupportedCapabilities: copies}, 'EXECUTION_PROFILE_ACTIVATION_UNSUPPORTED').
(d) strictRetention(state) -> {retainedStrictTasks, retainedStrictTaskIds, retainedStrictAttempts, retainedStrictAttemptIds, unreadableSnapshots}. Over state.tasks: a task whose stored snapshot decodes with profile 'verified-local', and currentAttempt(state, id) whose snapshot does. Ids sorted ascending and capped at 10 (moe.get_activity_log truncates any payload value over 500 chars); counts are totals. A snapshot or attempt that fails to decode or copy is counted in unreadableSnapshots, never echoed. Never throws.
(e) updateProjectSettings(state, input): Promise<Project>, today's StateManager.updateSettings body plus recording:
  1. if (!state.project) throw new Error('Project not loaded') (unchanged).
  2. from = resolveExecutionProfile(project.settings), or 'unreadable' when it throws a MoeError.
  3. requested = input.executionProfile === 'verified-local'; gaps = requested ? activationGaps() : [].
  4. try { settings = validateSettingsUpdate(project, input) (unchanged; its unconditional readiness refusal fires first, so pinned NOT_READY refusals keep their exact shape); if (requested) { const gap = activationUnsupported(gaps); if (gap) throw gap; } } catch (error) { if requested and the error is a MoeError whose codeName is EXECUTION_PROFILE_NOT_READY or EXECUTION_PROFILE_ACTIVATION_UNSUPPORTED, await state.appendActivityAsync('PROJECT_SETTINGS_UPDATED', {setting:'executionProfile', from, to:'verified-local', transition:'activate', outcome:'refused', codeName, unsupportedCapabilities: gaps}); rethrow }.
  5. Write exactly as before: updated = {...project, settings, updatedAt: now}; await atomicWriteJsonAsync(path.join(state.moePath, 'project.json'), updated); state.project = updated. A failed write leaves memory unchanged and records nothing (StateManager.test 'does not update in-memory project when project write fails' must stay green).
  6. When input.executionProfile !== undefined and classifyProfileTransition(from, resolveExecutionProfile(settings)) is non-null: await state.appendActivityAsync('PROJECT_SETTINGS_UPDATED', {setting, from, to, transition, outcome:'applied', ...(transition === 'rollback' ? strictRetention(state) : {})}).
  7. state.emit({type:'SETTINGS_UPDATED', payload: updated}); return updated.
  Error handling: appendActivityAsync logs and swallows a failed append (the activity-log contract), so an audit failure never fails or reverts a change. The record is awaited, so it is on disk before the call resolves and is not subject to appendActivity's fire-and-forget backpressure drop.

StateManager.ts: replace updateSettings' body with `return updateProjectSettings(this, settings);` plus a one-line pointer comment, import it, and drop now-unused imports. `wc -l` must stay under the 1500-line budget (mem gotcha-statemanager-1500-line-budget). V03b (task-c9fe2515) lands StateManager edits first, so measure the landed file. Run the step-1 file: everything except S2 row a turns green.

implementationPlan.note:
Adversarial self-review of this task's diff only. No code change needed.

Each plan point:
- Concurrency: the only production caller is WebSocketServer UPDATE_SETTINGS (line 831) inside withMutex. The awaited record takes state.activityMutex, a separate mutex, so there is no deadlock and no interleaving between the write, the record and the emit.
- Audit is best-effort by the activity-log contract. appendActivityAsync logs and swallows a failed append (R6 proves the change still applies). A crash between the project write and the record loses the record. Rotation keeps 5 generations.
- A hand-edited project.json picked up by the FileWatcher reload is NOT recorded; only updateSettings is a control. Listed for M06.
- Scale: O(tasks x attempts) through currentAttempt, once per profile change, with ids capped at 10. There is a `ponytail:` comment.
- Malformed or over-deep task or attempt snapshots are caught per item and counted in unreadableSnapshots, never echoed (S1 counts task-M).
- No caller field can add a capability. activationGaps takes no input and reads no env (G1). Unknown fields such as capabilities or executionProfileReady are refused INVALID_INPUT before any record (G5). A `__proto__` key is an unknown field too.
- No authorization path reads the activity log. The only other reader is the WS GET_ACTIVITY_LOG display handler.
- Activation stays impossible:
  - WS: the validator's unconditional NOT_READY runs first;
  - env: G1 and the P2 pin;
  - client hello: I01 verifiedLocal is false;
  - persisted label: R2 (an unrelated update on a stored verified-local is refused NOT_READY);
  - even with readiness stubbed, ACTIVATION_UNSUPPORTED (G4).
- validators.ts, delivery/executionProfile.ts and the taskStore backstop are byte-unchanged vs HEAD (git diff --quiet).
- The complete_task change only adds a refusal where the open attempt's own snapshot is verified-local and the task-level profile is not. Everywhere else `strict` already implied a verified-local task-level profile.
- daemonGitDocs pattern: no hits, and the full gate including that test passed.
- No .moe edits and no Git writes.

Size: profileRollout.ts is 169 lines, and updateProjectSettings is about 35 lines. profileRollout.test.ts is 334 lines, over the 300 guideline (the plan estimated about 230), because of the plan-mandated case list (T1, G1-G5, R1-R6, S1, S2). The e2e file is 227 lines.

comments.content:
Plan rev 1 (architect-32ff5555, 2026-10-30), planned after the 2026-10-27 unblock.

Decisions:
1. Audit records: the existing PROJECT_SETTINGS_UPDATED activity event, read through moe.get_activity_log. No new store, tool, setting or UI.

executionContract.intendedBehavior:
executionProfile changes only through the existing settings path: WS UPDATE_SETTINGS -> StateManager.updateSettings, implemented in state/profileRollout.ts updateProjectSettings. Each profile transition writes one PROJECT_SETTINGS_UPDATED activity record, readable through moe.get_activity_log:
- legacy->observe: 'observe', applied.
- any lowering: 'rollback', applied, with counts and up to 10 sorted ids of tasks whose stored snapshot stays verified-local and of open attempts whose snapshot is verified-local.
- a verified-local request: 'activate', refused, with the refusal codeName and the unsupported vm/client/check capabilities.
Activation stays refused. The validator's unconditional readiness refusal is unchanged and runs first. A capability gate runs after it and refuses while any of VM, client or check is unsupported; today all three are. A rollback rewrites only project.json: tasks, attempts and evidence are untouched, and strict task snapshots keep their floor. complete_task refuses EXECUTION_PROFILE_NOT_READY for a running attempt whose own snapshot is verified-local, even after a rollback. Observe changes no authorization outcome relative to legacy.
acceptanceCriteria: Observe set through updateSettings is recorded and leaves completion, evidence, recipe and approval outcomes identical to legacy (E1-E3).

updateSettings({executionProfile:'verified-local'}) from absent, legacy or observe refuses with the canonical EXECUTION_PROFILE_NOT_READY {code, codeName, context}. It persists nothing in project.json, emits no SETTINGS_UPDATED, and records one refused 'activate' event naming vm, client and check.

With readiness stubbed as certified (test-only spy), activation is still refused EXECUTION_PROFILE_ACTIVATION_UNSUPPORTED. activationUnsupported refuses any single unsupported capability and returns null only when none is unsupported.

A rollback to legacy or observe leaves every .moe file except project.json and activity.log byte-identical. Stored verified-local task snapshots stay effective (get_context effectiveProfile verified-local; claim refused NOT_READY), and the record carries the exact retained counts and ids.

After a rollback, a running attempt with a verified-local snapshot still needs strict identity at step entry, and complete_task refuses it EXECUTION_PROFILE_NOT_READY with no write. An attempt without that snapshot completes under legacy, as F12 pins.
invariants: delivery/executionProfile.ts is byte-unchanged. assertExecutionProfileReady stays the only readiness authority and still refuses verified-local unconditionally.
No persisted label, environment variable, client hello or caller field can make activation succeed. The capability gate only refuses.
No authorization path reads the activity log or a rollout record.
validateSettingsUpdate precedence and messages are unchanged. Unrelated, malformed or failed-write updates produce no rollout record.
A rollback never rewrites tasks, attempts, candidates, checks, reviews or receipts, and the store progression backstop stays task-level.
